newsitem.title: THAILAND: About 90,000 T soybeans to arrive Thailand in Jan.
newsitem.headline: About 90,000 T soybeans to arrive Thailand in Jan.

text.p: A feared soymeal shortage in Thailand in January is unlikely as about 90,000 tonnes of soybeans and 50,000 tonnes of soymeal are expected to arrive this month, shipping sources said on Wednesday.
The prices of soymeal here rose this week on a rumour that soybeans imported by oil crushers from the United States could be delayed due to an accident in the Gulf of Mexico.
A vessel crashed into a riverside shopping area in New Orleans last month, sharply curtailing shipping at the port.
Vessel Or Han Ekaci arrived at a Thai port on Wednesday with 34,539 tonnes of U.S. soybeans. Thai Vegetable Oil is said to be the buyer with Louis Dreyfus as the seller.
Another vessel, Avalon, is expected to arrive on January 25 with 56,000 tonnes of soybeans, also of U.S. origin.
At least 48,676 additional tonnes of soymeal, mostly of Indian origin, is scheduled to be here within the month, the sources added.
